id.description: Unique identifier of the Change Type.

abbreviation.description: Short code/abbreviation for the Change Type shown in compact UI contexts. Null when no abbreviation is set.

company_id.description: ID of the Company that owns this Change Type. Pass as the company_id query parameter when listing Change Types.

change_type.description: Display name of the Change Type (e.g. Transfer, Allowance).

show_in_select.description: Whether this Change Type is available for selection in dropdowns/GUI.

403.description: User does not have permission to access Change Types.
